- review round 1, finding 1 (medium): OcrQueue.ReadCoreAsync keeps a cancelled run's partial pages but puts the document back to OcrStatus.Pending, and writes both with CancellationToken.None (the token that stopped the reading is already cancelled, so the old code would have thrown on the save). New test A_document_stopped_halfway_keeps_its_pages_and_stays_in_line drives a FakeEngine that cancels after page 3 of 20 and asserts Pending + 3 pages, then that a fresh queue's ResumeAsync finishes it to 20.
- review round 1, finding 2 (medium): DocumentService now has ActorAsync (the installation's EmployeeName, cached per scope) as CorrespondenceService does; the «أُضيف الملف …» audit line no longer says "system". Test The_audit_line_names_the_person_who_added_the_file.
- review round 1, finding 3 (medium): DocumentService.ScanAsync guards only on `_scanner is null`; whether a machine that has scanner support also has a device is the scanner's own answer. FakeScanner now models the real cached probe (HasDevice vs IsAvailable). Tests Scanning_before_the_device_list_was_ever_asked_for_still_scans and A_machine_that_has_a_scanner_answers_the_words_only_when_it_really_has_none.
- review round 1, finding 4 (low): WiaScanner.FindDevice wraps the loop body in try/finally with a `keep` flag, so every enumerated non-scanner device is released instead of leaking its COM wrapper.
- review round 1, finding 5 (low): TessdataLocator.Fingerprint folds LastWriteTimeUtc.Ticks in beside name and length. Test A_replacement_of_the_same_size_is_still_noticed.
- review round 1, finding 6 (low): the walk-up candidate only yields <dir>\tools\tessdata when <dir>\Wakeel.slnx exists, so a developer tree and the tests still find it and an installed product can never read models out of C:\tools\tessdata.
- review round 1, finding 7 (low): ScanPdfWriter.Combine counts the pages it actually wrote and throws when none was written; DocumentService.ScanAsync binds first, catches ArgumentException and falls through to storing the sheets separately. Tests Sheets_that_are_none_of_them_pictures_are_refused_rather_than_bound_into_nothing and Sheets_the_binder_cannot_make_a_document_of_are_kept_as_separate_pictures.
- review round 1, finding 8 (low): OcrQueue's _done increments moved inside _gate and Report reads the done/total pair under the same lock.
- review round 1, finding 9 (low): IDocumentService.ScanAsync's XML doc rewritten; it no longer cross-references DocumentImportState.KindNotAccepted.
- review round 1 (DONE): full command green. Core 682 passed / 1 skipped (Word absent) / 683, UI.Tests 340 passed, Walkthrough 24 passed. 0 warnings, 0 errors everywhere.
- review round 2, finding 1 (medium): DocumentService.ScanAsync now counts what is really in the vault (`stored`) and returns the store's own words when a sheet could not be written — the separate-pages loop keeps each page's result and stops on the first one that failed, so «تم مسح ...» never covers sheets nobody saved. Tests A_scan_the_vault_could_not_take_says_so_instead_of_counting_sheets (blocked vault folder + FakeScanner) and A_vault_that_goes_out_of_reach_halfway_never_counts_the_sheets_it_lost (FailingAfterStore wrapper).
- review round 2, finding 2 (low): VaultStore.CheckHash also requires hex (Uri.IsHexDigit), so a 64-character name with a separator can never resolve outside vault\ and a malformed name is refused before the key derivation. A_hash_that_is_not_a_hash_is_a_defect_and_not_a_state covers a 64-character path-separator value and a 64-character non-hex value.
- review round 2, finding 3 (low): WiaScanner.ReadName restructured like ReadProperty — both COM wrappers declared outside the try and released in a finally, one exit per outcome.
- review round 2, finding 4 (low): OcrService.ReadAsync no longer hands the token to Task.Run, and Read throws the cancellation itself at the top, so a run stopped before it started answers OcrState.Cancelled instead of faulting the queue. Test A_reading_asked_for_with_the_stop_already_pressed_answers_stopped.
- review round 2, finding 5 (low): OcrQueue.Enqueue delegates to a private TryEnqueue(Guid, OcrPriority) that reports whether it added an entry; ResumeAsync counts that instead of projecting and sorting the whole waiting list twice per document.
